page_title: Which AI Agent Instruction Files Does Your Repo Need?

sources.entry: Repo Agent Kit - Free, privacy-first browser tools for creating, auditing, and adapting repository instructions for Codex and other coding agents. #free

summary.name: Repo Agent Kit
summary.one_liner: A free, browser-local tool that builds a minimal set of AI coding agent instruction files (AGENTS.md plus bridge files) for six coding agents from your tool selections.
use_cases: Choose which instruction files a repo needs across multiple coding agents
Create a shared AGENTS.md with commands, guardrails, and a definition of done
Set up CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, and Copilot bridge files that point to AGENTS.md
Audit a public repository for agent-readiness
Generate a starter AGENTS.md from a project manifest
summary.what_it_does: The page lets you select from six coding agents (OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Devin Desktop formerly Windsurf) and returns a recommended file plan. The plan centers on AGENTS.md as the shared source, with thin bridge files such as CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, and .github/copilot-instructions.md that import or point to it. It also notes tool-specific paths for scoped rules (for example .cursor/rules/*.mdc and .devin/rules/*.md). A live preview shows a sample AGENTS.md for a sample Next.js project, and the page describes a manifest import that detects commands and a public repo audit. The page states that the planner and generator run in the browser and that nothing is uploaded.
notable: Recommends a minimal file set (4 files for 6 tools) with AGENTS.md as the single source of truth
Runs locally in the browser; no sign-up and no uploads for the generator
Public repo audit that needs no GitHub sign-in and does not request private repositories
caveats: Cursor's AGENTS.md support is described as applying at the project root; directory or pattern scoping needs native .cursor/rules files
Copilot @ file references are documented only for Copilot CLI, so other Copilot surfaces may need a self-contained bridge
The page does not state whether the repo audit or manifest import has limits
